stem: Which of these best explains why worldwide reactions to U.S. involvement in Vietnam grew increasingly hostile during the late 1960s and early 1970s?

options.label: A
options.text: The United States was viewed as appeasing a brutal dictator.

options.label: B
options.text: The United States demanded the unconditional surrender of Ho Chi Minh.

options.label: C
options.text: The United States was viewed as an aggressor invading an underdeveloped nation.

options.label: D
options.text: The United States ignored a United Nations Security Council resolution to cease hostilities.
